recs.stt: Supporting Linux kernel development in Rust
recs.x: no (intra-language) mechanism for verification beyond the basic type system. You could say that Rust is all-or-nothing, while ATS allows gradual verification, as well as proving safe much more complex code than you can in Rust. I'm not going to claim that ATS is overall better than Rust - it's not - but it's a far more powerful language than Rust for safe systems programming. It's just that most people are not willing or able to pay the very high price in ergonomics.
